verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly says operations can run "from your terminal, a script, or a CI pipeline" through a terminal-native CLI and a REST API. The CLI supports non-interactive auth via the MERCURY_API_KEY environment variable, and scoped read-only, read-write and custom tokens plus a separate sandbox base URL enable safe automated testing before swapping to production. Missing for 10: in-depth CLI/CI documentation (e.g. a CI pipeline example, non-interactive flags, exit-code behavior) and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
